final_answer:
The bug was in `compute_tax` in `src/invoicer/tax.py`. It used floor division (`//`), so it rounded down. ADR 0001 says money rounds half up. A 1005-cent subtotal at 8.25% gave 82 cents instead of 83.

I changed it to use the existing `round_half_up` helper from `money.py`. All 10 tests pass now, including the two that were failing (`test_rounds_half_up` and the CLI `test_total`).

I haven't committed the change.
